ei.title: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

fullPassage:
Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①주목받지 못한 ②별개의 ③그것의(its) ④적들
det.analysis:
✅ ③ it → its: 소유격 'its advantage'가 필요. it은 주격/목적격이므로 소유격 its로 수정
❌ ①②④: 모두 적절
det.tip: it(주격/목적격) vs its(소유격) vs it's(it is) — 명사 앞에는 소유격

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during ①<u>peacefully</u> times, people lived in and around the eupseong. Surrounded by ②<u>low</u> walls, the area ③<u>housed</u> administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for ④<u>soldiers</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①평화로운(peaceful) ②낮은 ③수용했다 ④군인들

❌ ②③④: 모두 적절
det.tip: peaceful(형용사: 평화로운) vs peacefully(부사: 평화롭게) — 명사 앞에는 형용사

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①등장했다 ②결합한 ③건설된 ④역할하며(serving)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ served → serving: 'while also serving as ~' — while 뒤에 분사구문이므로 현재분사 serving이 필요. served는 과거 시제 동사로 분사구문에 부적합
❌ ①②③: 모두 적절
det.tip: while (also) ~ing: while 뒤 분사구문은 현재분사 / while also serving = ~의 역할도 하면서

questions.passage: Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its ①<u>advantage</u>. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①이점 ②더 높은 ③부족한 ④(안쪽에→)바깥에(outside)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ inside(안쪽에) → outside(바깥에): 일반 백성(농부)은 성벽 '바깥에' 살았음
❌ ①②③: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: outside(바깥에) ↔ inside(안쪽에) / 일반 백성 = 성벽 바깥 거주

questions.passage: After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress ①<u>vanished</u> that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①(사라졌다→)등장했다(emerged) ②방어 ③농업 ④상업

❌ ②③④: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
